translation.title: Piroxicam Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), tenosynovitis, muscle pain, osteoarticular pain, pain after an injury, and pain after a fracture has healed.
translation.usage: Apply 1 patch to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to piroxicam preparations or have experienced such hypersensitivity, if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (an asthma attack triggered by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics), if aspirin or another non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesic has caused hives, rhinitis, or angioedema, if you have been pregnant for 6 months or more, or if the user is a child aged 14 years or under. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are hypersensitive or have experienced hypersensitivity, if you are receiving an anticoagulant, if you have or have had a gastrointestinal ulcer, bleeding or perforation, peptic ulcer, liver impairment, or kidney impairment, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or if you are elderly. If your symptoms do not improve after about one week of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it on skin with lesions (haemorrhagic skin disease, eczema, infected lesions, burns, wounds), on the eyes, or on mucous membranes. Do not use an occlusive dressing. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you use it together with an anticoagulant. Shock may occur, and local itching, redness, rash, scaling, eczema, dermatitis, contact dermatitis, or erythema occasionally, and photosensitivity rarely. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
